visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Lookup Table Instead of an if-Chain
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A long if / else-if chain returns the value of each symbol. Use two parallel tables: a string of symbols and an array of values. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Data in a table replaces a chain of seven near-identical branches, and the symbol and its value sit at the same index. (This version assumes the input holds only valid Roman letters.)
